description: 37-page English annual technical report of a fictitious regional water supply network, typeset with Typst 0.15 in one continuous flow (justified, hyphenated, breakable tables with repeated header rows, footnotes, display and inline formulas, running header and 'Page N of M' footer). The filler text is generated from a fixed seed. Early edit: a new subsection '1.3 Changes to the reporting basis' with four paragraphs inserted on page 1, which re-paginates everything after it. Late edits: an October turbidity value in Table 9.1, a sampling interval, the temperature coefficient in an inline formula, a paragraph moved from chapter 10 to chapter 12, a footnote wording, a paragraph deleted in chapter 11, a sentence set in bold, and a change value in the summary Table 12.1. Consequences only: subsections 1.3 to 1.4 renumber, every later page starts at a different point of the text, table breaks and repeated header rows move, and the moved and deleted paragraphs shift the following pages. Producer: Typst 0.15.0 (Python package typst 0.15.0), Libertinus Serif and New Computer Modern Math embedded by Typst. Synthetic sample: all parties, places and figures are fictitious.
